This allows a person to save mental energy and quickly make decisions in familiar conditions. However, automatic reactions do not always correspond to new circumstances. Therefore, it is important for a person to periodically review their habits and learn new ways of behaving. Subconscious and conscious The subconscious and the conscious are not opponents. The subconscious is responsible for speed. Consciousness is responsible for understanding. The subconscious offers ready-made solutions. Consciousness evaluates them and changes them if necessary. Thanks to this, a person is able not only to use past experience, but also to go beyond it. Development of the subconscious The subconscious changes gradually. Its development occurs through: regular practice; repetition of useful actions; forming new habits; physical exercises; training; emotionally significant experience; lifestyle change. Each repeated action gradually becomes part of the automatic human control system. The main principle The subconscious is not created to limit a person. Its task is to preserve life, conserve the body's resources and use accumulated experience. Consciousness helps a person to update this experience. Will turns new decisions into actions. Repetition makes new actions habits. This is how the subconscious develops and, along with it, the person himself develops. Definition The subconscious is a deep system of automatic human control, combining biological mechanisms of self-regulation, acquired skills, emotional memory, and accumulated experience, ensuring the body's adaptation and effective interaction with the outside world. In the New Psychology of DREVO, the subconscious is viewed as the foundation upon which conscious choice, personal development, and the human capacity for further creation are built. Psyche Psyche— is the system through which a person perceives the world, processes information, experiences emotions, remembers experiences, makes decisions, and adapts to the environment. Figuratively speaking: Body— action tool. Psyche— perception and control system. Soul— the inner core of personality, values ​​and meaning (within the framework of your philosophical model). Spirit- the power of direction, will and following the chosen path. Basic functions of the psyche The psyche is responsible for: perception; attention; memory; thinking; imagination; emotions; speech; training; decision making; adaptation to changing conditions. It is the psyche that allows a person to learn from experience and change their behavior. The main task of the psyche Its main function isensure survival and effective interaction with the environmentTherefore, the psyche constantly evaluates: safe or dangerous; useful or harmful; familiar or unknown; possible or impossible. Many automatic reactions—anxiety, alertness, habits—can be seen as adaptive mechanisms. Healthy psyche Signs of psychological well-being may include: flexibility of thinking; emotional stability; ability to learn; adequate perception of reality; self-regulation; ability to build relationships. Interaction Within your model: Bodyprovides energy and physical capabilities. Psycheanalyzes the situation and suggests options for action. Soulhelps to determine what corresponds to internal values. Spirithelps to implement the chosen direction, even when it is difficult. This distinction can be usefulphilosophical model of manFrom a scientific perspective, psychology and neuroscience study the psyche as a set of cognitive, emotional, and behavioral processes, while the concepts of "soul" and "spirit" remain the subject of philosophy, religious studies, and certain areas of the humanities. New psychology explores how values, meaning, and worldview influence observable behavior and human well-being, maintaining a distinction between verifiable scientific data and philosophical concepts. Consciousness Consciousness— is a person’s ability to be aware of themselves, the surrounding world, and their own internal processes, as well as to direct attention and make choices. If the psyche continuously processes information, then consciousness allows us to see this work and, to a certain extent, influence it. In this model Body— it works. Psyche— perceives, feels, remembers, analyzes. Consciousness- observes, realizes, chooses. Soul— sets deep values ​​and a sense of authenticity. Spirit- gives direction, meaning and determination to follow the chosen path. Basic functions of consciousness Consciousness allows a person to: to be aware of one's existence; notice your thoughts and emotions; manage attention; make informed choices; predict the consequences of actions; reflect on yourself and the world; learn from your own experience. Levels of consciousness As a philosophical model, several levels can be distinguished: Consciousness of perception- "I see and hear." Self-awareness— “I understand that this is happening to me.” Reflexive consciousness- “I can observe my thoughts and feelings.” Value consciousness— “I realize what I consider right and important.” Creative consciousness- "I am able to create new ideas and transform the world." Development of consciousness The development of consciousness is not just the accumulation of knowledge, but the growth of ability: notice automatic reactions; separate facts from interpretations; maintain clarity of thinking in difficult situations; make decisions in line with your values; understand other people. Possible definition Consciousness is a person's ability to be aware of themselves and the world, to direct their attention, to analyze their own mental processes, and to make informed decisions. It serves as the link between perception, values, and actions. Will Will in the New Psychology of DREVO Will is a person’s ability to control himself and make conscious choices. It allows a person to turn intentions into actions, remain true to their values, and continue moving towards their chosen goal regardless of internal and external obstacles. If consciousness answers the question: "What do I choose?" then the will answers: "Am I capable of implementing this choice?" It is the will that connects thought with action. What does the will do? Will helps a person: manage your actions; manage your attention; manage your habits; overcome fear; delaying immediate gratification for a long-term goal; maintain discipline; implement the decisions made; be responsible for your own life. Will makes a man his own master. Will and freedom Freedom does not begin when all restrictions disappear. Freedom begins when a person is able to choose his actions, and not be completely subject to instincts, emotions, habits or external pressure. Therefore, will is the basis of inner freedom. The better a person can manage himself, the more opportunities open up to him. Will and consciousness Consciousness helps to see different options for action. It analyzes, compares and makes decisions. But the solution itself is not enough. Without will, even the right decision can remain just an intention. Consciousness determines direction. The will begins to move. Will and subconscious The subconscious controls habitual automatic actions. Willpower allows us to change these automatic programs. Every time a person consciously chooses a new way of behavior and repeats it regularly, the will gradually forms a new habit. Over time, the new habit becomes part of the subconscious. Thus, will is the main instrument for personal development. Will and spirit In the New Psychology of DREVO, the spirit determines the direction of a person’s life. Willpower helps to move in this direction. The Spirit answers the question: "For what?" Will answers: "What needs to be done now?" Therefore, a strong spirit without will remains an intention. And a strong will without values ​​can be used for both creation and destruction. A mature personality combines will with responsibility, moral values ​​and respect for life. How is willpower strengthened? Will develops in the same way as a muscle develops. It is strengthened through regular practice. The main methods of its development are: keeping promises made to yourself; discipline; gradual increase in complexity of tasks; the ability to bring things to completion; development of self-control; attention management; overcoming the habit of putting off important things; conscious refusal to take actions that contradict one's own values. Every conscious action strengthens the ability to manage oneself. Signs of a developed will A person with a developed will: makes decisions independently; keeps promises; able to manage one's emotions and behavior; does not give up at the first difficulties; knows how to wait for results; maintains direction of movement; is responsible for the consequences of his actions. The main principle The will does not exist to suppress man. Its task is to harmonize desires, emotions, reason and values, directing them towards a conscious goal. The better a person can manage himself, the freer his life becomes. Definition Willpower is a person's ability to consciously control themselves, make informed choices, and consistently implement them in actions, remaining true to their values ​​and accepting responsibility for the consequences of their actions. In DREVO's New Psychology, will is viewed as the link between consciousness and action. It is through will that knowledge becomes action, action becomes habit, habit becomes character, and character becomes the foundation of a creative life.

title: Superconsciousness
excerpt: The Superconscious in New Psychology DREVO In the New Psychology of DREVO, the superconscious is considered as a level of personality associated with going beyond the limits of already accumulated experience. If the subc
text: The Superconscious in New Psychology DREVO In the New Psychology of DREVO, the superconscious is considered as a level of personality associated with going beyond the limits of already accumulated experience. If the subconscious stores the past, and the conscious is aware of the present and makes choices, then the superconscious helps a person discover what is not yet in his personal experience. It is thanks to the superconscious that a person is able to create something new. Main function The main function of the superconscious is the birth of new opportunities. It manifests itself in: creativity; inspiration; scientific discoveries; artistic thinking; deep intuition; ability to see the big picture; non-standard solutions to complex problems; the emergence of new meanings. The superconscious does not repeat the known. It helps to go beyond it. How does the superconscious mind work? The new psychology of DREVO views the superconscious as a process in which consciousness ceases to be limited only by already known knowledge and becomes open to new combinations of ideas, deep insights, and creative exploration. Modern cognitive psychology describes many such phenomena through processes of unconscious information processing, insight, creativity, and associative thinking. In the DREVO model, the term "supraconscious" unites these processes into a single philosophical concept. Sources of the superconscious The superconscious develops thanks to: deep study of knowledge; reflection; creativity; observation of nature; scientific research; art; long-term concentration; open exploration of the new; dialogue with other people. The richer a person's experience and the freer his thinking, the more opportunities there are for new ideas to emerge. Superconsciousness and consciousness Consciousness asks a question. The superconscious helps to see an unexpected answer. Consciousness analyzes. The superconscious unites. Consciousness moves step by step. The superconscious mind sometimes allows us to see the solution as a whole. That is why great discoveries are often born after long preparation and a period of inner searching. Superconsciousness and soul The soul helps a person remain true to his inner nature. The superconscious helps to find new ways of its manifestation. One is responsible for authenticity. The other is for creativity. Together they allow a person to create something that did not exist before. How does the superconscious develop? The superconscious cannot be forced to work. But it is possible to create conditions for its development. These conditions are: continuous learning; curiosity; exploratory thinking; creativity; silence and concentration; contemplation of nature; openness to new ideas; respect for facts; willingness to reconsider one's own views. The superconscious develops where a person stops looking only for confirmation of what is already known and begins to seek a new understanding of the world. The main principle The subconscious stores the past. Consciousness chooses the present. The superconscious reveals the future. It is thanks to the superconscious that a person is able not only to repeat the experience of previous generations, but also to expand the boundaries of human knowledge and culture. Definition The superconscious is a conceptual level of personality in the New Psychology of DREVO, associated with creative search, the emergence of new ideas, a holistic vision, and the ability to go beyond the boundaries of accumulated experience. It helps people create knowledge, art, technology and new ways of understanding the world. It is the superconscious that transforms the accumulated experience of humanity into discoveries that become the basis for future development. Soul The Soul in New Psychology DREVO In the New Psychology of DREVO, the soul is viewed as the inner core of the personality, the source of its authenticity, moral choice and striving for love, beauty and creation. The soul does not answer the question,Howa man lives. She answers the question: "Who am I?" It is through the soul that a person feels his own uniqueness and inner integrity. What is the soul? The soul is that inner principle through which a person experiences himself as a unique individual. It unites: self-esteem; Love; conscience; compassion; the ability to admire beauty; striving for truth; deep values; experiencing the meaning of life. In the New Psychology of DREVO, the soul is considered as a philosophical concept that describes a person’s inner experience and their personal integrity. The main function of the soul The main function of the soul is to preserve the authenticity of the personality. It is the soul that helps a person not to lose himself among circumstances, social roles and external pressure. It helps to distinguish: not only profitable, but also correct; not only pleasant, but also valuable; not only possible, but also worthy. Soul and consciousness Consciousness helps us understand what is happening. The soul helps to understand whether what is happening corresponds to the inner nature of a person. Consciousness responds: "What's happening?" The soul answers: "Does this match who I want to be?" Soul and will The soul determines inner values. Will helps to live in accordance with them. Without will, even the highest aspirations can remain just wishes. Without a soul, a strong will can be used for both creation and destruction. Soul and spirit In New Psychology DREVO these concepts have different functions. The soul is responsible for the inner essence of a person. The spirit determines the direction of its development. The soul retains its authenticity. The spirit helps to bring it to life. Revealing the Soul The soul opens up gradually. It becomes noticeable through a person's actions. It cannot be revealed by reflection alone. It is revealed through: Love; honesty; creativity; care; service; Gratitude; responsibility; respect for life; striving for truth. Every creative act helps a person to more fully express his inner essence. Signs of an open soul A man with an open soul: maintains dignity; capable of love; respects other people; strives for justice; knows how to sympathize; creates more than it destroys; remains true to his values; brings benefits to the surrounding world. An open soul makes a person a source of trust, inspiration and creation. The main principle The soul is not revealed through possession. It is revealed through manifestation. It is not what a person has, and what kind of person he becomes, shows the depth of his soul's revelation. Definition The soul is the inner core of the personality, uniting its authenticity, conscience, love, moral values ​​and the desire for creation. In DREVO's New Psychology, the soul is viewed as a philosophical concept that helps describe a person's inner integrity, their ability to remain true to themselves, and to translate their values ​​into action. The soul is revealed not by words, but by life. The more love, wisdom, responsibility, and creativity a person displays in their actions, the more fully their soul is revealed. Spirit Spirit in the New Psychology of DREVO In the New Psychology DREVO, the spirit is seen as an internal force that determines the direction of human development. If the soul answers the question: "Who am I?" then the spirit answers: "Who do I strive to become and what do I live for?" The spirit guides a person forward. It helps you not to rest on your laurels, to overcome difficulties and to realize your values ​​in life. What is spirit? Spirit is the inner capacity of a person to rise above his limitations for a higher purpose. It manifests itself in: striving for truth; freedom; responsibility; courage; dignity; selflessness; the desire for creation; readiness to serve life. In the New Psychology of DREVO, spirit is viewed as a philosophical concept that describes the inner direction of the individual and their ability to live for values ​​that go beyond momentary desires. The main function of the spirit The main function of the spirit is to set the direction of development. The body is responsible for life. The psyche is for perception. Consciousness is for choice. Will — for action. The spirit is responsible for the direction in which a person uses all this. It helps not just to move, but to understand where and why the movement is directed. Spirit and will Will is responsible for the ability to control oneself. The spirit is responsible for the meaning of this management. You can have a strong will, but use it for destruction. The spirit connects willpower with moral values ​​and creative purpose. Therefore, a strong spirit is not only the ability to overcome difficulties, but also the ability to choose a path that preserves human dignity and respect for life. Spirit and soul Soul and spirit are not opposed to each other. They perform different tasks. The soul preserves the inner authenticity of a person. The Spirit helps this authenticity become a way of life. The soul is responsible for the inner content. Spirit - for direction and embodiment. The soul is the source of values. The spirit transforms values ​​into a way of life. How is the spirit strengthened? The spirit develops through real actions. It is strengthened: acceptance of responsibility; true to one's word; overcoming difficulties; service to people; honesty; discipline; the desire for knowledge; creative work; protection of human dignity; concern for future generations. Every action that is consistent with internal values ​​makes the spirit stronger. Signs of a strong spirit A man with a strong spirit: does not give up his values ​​under pressure of circumstances; able to maintain dignity even in difficult times; does not look for the guilty, but looks for solutions; knows how to take responsibility; inspires others by his own example; uses his power for protection and creation, not for domination. Strength of spirit is not measured by power over other people. It is measured by the ability to remain true to the best in oneself. The main principle The spirit does not exist for the sake of power, superiority or glory. It exists for the development of life. The stronger a person's spirit becomes, the greater his ability to create, unite, protect and inspire. Definition Spirit is the inner strength and direction of personal development that allows a person to live in accordance with their highest values, consciously overcome difficulties, and use their abilities for creation. In the New Psychology of DREVO, spirit is viewed as a philosophical concept that reflects a person's ability to transcend selfish interests, accept responsibility for their actions, and direct their lives for the benefit of people, society, and future generations. If the soul answers the question “Who am I?”, then the spirit answers the question “Who am I becoming and what trace will I leave behind?”

title: Values ​​and meaning
excerpt: Values ​​and Meaning in the New Psychology of DREVO In the New Psychology DREVO, values ​​and meaning are seen as the internal compass of the individual. They help a person not only make decisions, but also understand wh
text: Values ​​and Meaning in the New Psychology of DREVO In the New Psychology DREVO, values ​​and meaning are seen as the internal compass of the individual. They help a person not only make decisions, but also understand why he lives, develops and acts. If the body is responsible for life, the psyche is for perception, consciousness is for choice, will - for action, soul - for authenticity, and spirit for direction, then values ​​and meaning determine,Why does a person choose this particular path?. What are values? Values ​​are the most significant principles and guidelines that a person follows in his life. They help to distinguish: important from unimportant; good from evil; creation from destruction; temporary benefit from a long-term good. It is values ​​that determine the quality of decisions made. Basic human values In the New Psychology DREVO, the core values ​​include: life; Love; freedom; dignity; responsibility; honesty; justice; respect; cooperation; knowledge; creativity; health; family; world; nature; creation. This list reflects the values ​​that underlie DREVO's philosophy. Individuals and cultures may prioritize them differently. What is meaning? Meaning is a person’s understanding of why he lives, develops and acts. Meaning unites individual events of life into a single story. It helps a person see the direction even when the path becomes difficult. Without a sense of meaning, even great achievements may not bring satisfaction. With a meaningful purpose, even difficult challenges can be perceived as part of growth. How is meaning formed? The meaning is not always found instantly. It is gradually born through: life experience; training; Love; work; creativity; raising children; helping other people; participation in the development of society; service to the chosen cause. For many people, meaning is also connected to worldview, philosophical or religious beliefs. Meaning develops along with a person. Values ​​and Choice Every decision reflects a person's value system. When actions are consistent with internal values, a person feels whole. When a person regularly acts contrary to his own beliefs, internal conflict arises. Therefore, psychological health cannot be completely separated from the consistency between values ​​and lifestyle. Values ​​and Society Personal values ​​influence not only the person himself. They become part of the culture of the family, community and society. When people choose honesty, responsibility, and cooperation, trust is strengthened. When lies, violence and indifference prevail, social bonds weaken. Therefore, the development of the individual simultaneously becomes a contribution to the development of society. Values ​​and Purpose Purpose cannot be realized without values. It is values ​​that help determine how a person will use his abilities. The same force can create or destroy. It is the values ​​that determine the direction of its application. The main principle A person develops not only thanks to knowledge. It develops thanks to the values ​​it allows to guide its life. Knowledge answers the question: "What is possible?" Values ​​answer: "What is right?" The meaning answers: "For what?" When these three elements are combined, a person becomes capable of conscious and creative development. Definition Values ​​are internal principles that define a person's attitude toward life, people, and themselves. Meaning is an understanding of why a person lives and uses their abilities. In the New Psychology of DREVO, values ​​and meaning are viewed as an internal compass of the individual, which unites knowledge, freedom of choice, will, and actions into a single direction of development. It's not circumstances that determine a person's quality of life. It's largely determined by the values ​​they choose and the meaning they attach to their actions. Social connections Social Connections in New Psychology DREVO In the New Psychology DREVO, social connections are considered a natural environment for personality development. Man is born among people, develops among people, and reveals most of his abilities through interaction with others. If the body provides life, the psyche helps to understand the world, consciousness allows you to choose, will helps to act, the soul retains its authenticity, the spirit sets the direction, and values ​​determine meaning, then social connections create a space in which all this manifests itself in real life. Man is a social being A person does not develop in complete isolation. Language emerges through communication. Thinking develops through dialogue. Culture is transmitted between people. Knowledge is born in collaboration. Love, friendship, trust, responsibility and mutual assistance also arise in relationships. Personality is revealed through interaction with other people. Basic levels of social connections Social connections develop gradually. Family The first environment of life. It is here that a person receives his first experience of love, security, communication and trust. Genus A source of historical memory, family traditions and continuity of generations. Family helps a person understand their origins and feel the connection between the past, present and future. Community A voluntary association of people who share common values, interests, or goals. The community becomes a space for cooperation and joint development. Society A broader system of relationships between people. Society creates education, culture, economics, law, science and other institutions that allow people to realize their abilities. Humanity The highest level of social connections. Despite the differences in cultures, languages ​​and states, all people belong to a single human community. Today's global challenges—climate change, pandemics, technological advances, space exploration—require cooperation across all of humanity. Basic needs for social connections Every person needs: love; acceptance; respect; trust; accessories; mutual support; opportunities to be useful; joint creativity. These needs are an important part of psychological well-being. Relationship quality It is not the number of acquaintances that determines the quality of social connections. Of primary importance are: trust; honesty; respect; openness; responsibility; ability to dialogue; willingness to help each other. These are the qualities that create strong relationships. Social connections and personal development Every person simultaneously receives and gives. Gains knowledge. Receives support. Gains experience. But at the same time it conveys: own knowledge; care; ideas; experience; help; inspiration. Thus, development becomes a mutual process. Social connections and creation Most of humanity's great achievements have been made possible through cooperation. Scientific discoveries. Works of art. Cities. University. Technologies. Environmental projects. All of them are the result of the combined efforts of many people. Therefore, social connections become the basis of a creative civilization. The main principle A person develops not in spite of other people. It develops along with them. The stronger the trust, cooperation and mutual respect, the more opportunities are revealed to each person. True personal development is impossible without the development of human relationships. Definition Social ties are a system of relationships between a person and his family, clan, community, society and humanity, through which personality is formed, knowledge is transmitted, culture is created and joint development is carried out. In the New Psychology of DREVO, social connections are considered one of the most important foundations of psychological health, since it is through relationships that people discover their abilities, learn to cooperate, and transform personal development into a contribution to the lives of others. One person can achieve much. But it is through social connections that individuals become families, families become communities, communities become societies, and societies create civilization. Interaction with nature Interacting with Nature in the New Psychology of DREVO In the New Psychology of DREVO, nature is viewed not as an external environment existing separately from man, but as the natural basis of his life and development. Man is a part of nature. His body consists of the same chemical elements as the surrounding world. It depends on air, water, food, sunlight, soil, plants and many living organisms. Therefore, psychological health cannot be completely separated from the state of the natural environment. Man as a part of a living system Man is not above nature. He is one of its elements. Just as a tree cannot be separated from soil, water and sunlight, humans cannot exist without natural ecosystems. Every breath we take, every sip of water we take, and every meal we eat reminds us of our connection to the world around us. Nature and development of man Throughout human history, the natural environment has shaped human development. Change of day and night. Seasons of the year. Climate. Flora and fauna. Landscape. These factors have influenced and continue to influence people's lifestyle, health and psychological state. Modern research shows that regular contact with nature is associated with reduced stress levels, improved mood, and increased subjective well-being in many people, although the extent of these effects may vary. Nature as a source of restoration Nature creates conditions for human recovery. Silence. Fresh air. Natural lighting. Movement. A variety of natural sounds. Contemplation of living forms. For many people, such conditions help reduce mental stress, restore attention and emotional balance. Therefore, interaction with nature is seen as an important part of a healthy lifestyle. Nature and Consciousness Nature reminds people of the laws of life's development. The tree is in no hurry to grow. The river does not fight with every stone. The forest exists thanks to the interaction of many organisms. Observing nature helps a person develop patience, attention, the ability to see connections and think long-term. These conclusions are a philosophical understanding of natural processes within the framework of the DREVO model. Human responsibility Man is capable of changing the environment. Every decision he makes affects nature. Use of resources. Production. Construction. Agriculture. Technologies. All these actions can both preserve natural systems and disrupt their stability. Therefore, a person’s responsibility extends not only to his own life, but also to the environment he leaves for future generations. Environmental awareness Ecological awareness begins with understanding interconnectedness. People care about nature not only because it is useful. He does this because he recognizes himself as part of a single system of life. Caring for water, soil, forests, animals and climate becomes an extension of caring for people themselves. Nature and Creation The highest form of human interaction with nature is not consumption, but creation. This can manifest itself through: forest restoration; biodiversity conservation; sustainable agriculture; development of environmental technologies; rational use of natural resources; creating cities that blend harmoniously with the natural environment. Man becomes not only a user of nature, but also its responsible custodian. The main principle Nature is not an external object. She is a part of a person. And man is a part of nature. By destroying nature, man gradually weakens the conditions of his own life. By preserving and restoring it, he simultaneously strengthens the health of present and future generations. Definition Interaction with nature is a continuous process of mutual influence between humans and the natural environment, in which humans receive conditions for life and development, and through their decisions and actions change the world around them. In the New Psychology of DREVO, interaction with nature is considered one of the fundamental levels of personal development. Human harmony is impossible without harmony with nature, as life's development always occurs through connection, cooperation, and responsibility. Just as a tree cannot live without a forest, water, soil and sun, a person cannot fully develop without living nature, of which he is a part.

title: The connection between the psyche, hormones and the body
excerpt: Unity of the organism In the New Psychology DREVO, a person is viewed as a single biopsychological system. The psyche does not exist separately from the body. The body does not exist separately from the psyche. There is
text: Unity of the organism In the New Psychology DREVO, a person is viewed as a single biopsychological system. The psyche does not exist separately from the body. The body does not exist separately from the psyche. There is a constant two-way exchange of information between them. Every thought has the potential to influence the physiology of the body. Every physiological change can affect the state of the psyche. This is why human health cannot be divided into “physical” and “psychological”. What are emotions? In the New Psychology DREVO, emotions are considered aspsychophysiological reaction of the bodyon internal and external events. Emotion occurs when the brain evaluates what is happening as significant for a person's life, safety, needs, or values. After this, a whole complex of processes is launched: the functioning of the nervous system changes; hormones and neurotransmitters are released; breathing changes; heart rhythm changes; muscle tone changes; facial expression changes; behavior changes. Thus, emotion is not just an experience. This is a reaction of the whole organism. Hormones and the psyche Hormones are chemical messengers between the brain and the body. They help the body adapt to changing conditions. For example: adrenaline prepares the body for quick action; Cortisol is involved in the response to long-term stress; Oxytocin is associated with the formation of trust and social bonds; dopamine is involved in motivation and learning processes; Serotonin affects mood and many other functions of the body. Each hormone performs multiple functions. Their effects depend on their interactions with each other, the nervous system, health, and the specific situation. The body as the language of the psyche The body constantly informs a person about its condition. These signals are manifested through: muscle tension; breath; fatigue; pain; appetite; dream; changes in heart rhythm; energy level. Psychological state and physiology are closely interconnected. Therefore, working with the body can contribute to improving the psychological state, and working with the psyche can have a beneficial effect on the functioning of the body. A vicious circle Thoughts influence emotions. Emotions change the functioning of the hormonal system. Hormones affect the state of the body. The body is influenced by new thoughts and emotions. In this way a single cycle is formed. It can support both health and chronic stress. Break the negative cycle A person is able to influence the system from different sides. Through: physical activity; good sleep; nutrition; breathing practices; awareness; psychotherapy; support of loved ones; creativity; rest; lifestyle change. Any positive change in one link gradually affects the entire system. The main principle The psyche and the body are two manifestations of one living system. It is impossible to fully restore psychological health by ignoring the state of the body. And it is impossible to achieve full physical health without completely ignoring your psychological state. Definition In the New Psychology of DREVO, emotions are viewed as a psychophysiological reaction of the body, arising as a result of the combined work of the brain, nervous system, hormonal system and body. The psyche, hormones and body form a single self-regulating system in which every change is reflected at other levels. A person does not "have" a separate body and psyche. A person is a single living system in which thoughts, feelings, hormones, and physiology continuously interact with one another. How does sleep affect personality? Sleep in the New Psychology of DREVO In the New Psychology DREVO, sleep is considered one of the most important processes of human recovery. During sleep, it is not only the body that rests. The brain continues to work. The functioning of the nervous system is stabilized. Hormonal balance is regulated. Memory is consolidated. The experiences of the past day are being processed. Therefore, the quality of sleep affects almost all levels of personality. Sleep and body During sleep, the body restores its resources. What's happening: tissue restoration; strengthening the immune system; regulation of metabolism; muscle recovery; hormonal changes; energy accumulation. Chronic lack of sleep gradually weakens the body and reduces its ability to adapt to stress. Sleep and the psyche The psyche uses sleep for emotional processing of experience. After a good night's sleep, a person usually feels better: keep calm; manage emotions; cope with stress; make decisions; concentrate attention. Lack of sleep increases the likelihood of irritability, anxiety, and emotional instability. Sleep and consciousness During sleep, the brain continues to process information received during the day. A good night's sleep helps: training; memory consolidation; search for new solutions; development of creative thinking. Sometimes after sleep a person finds the answer to a question that he had been unable to solve for a long time. Sleep and Will Lack of sleep reduces a person's ability to control their impulses. It's getting harder for him: maintain discipline; keep promises; resist bad habits; make informed decisions. Therefore, the development of willpower is impossible without taking care of adequate sleep. Sleep and the emotional body During chronic sleep deprivation, the body often perceives ordinary situations as more stressful. This is due to changes in the functioning of the nervous system and hormonal regulation. Therefore, sometimes the cause of irritability is not a person’s character, but insufficient recovery of the body. Sleep and creativity During sleep, the brain is able to connect already known information in new ways. Therefore, after rest the following may appear: new ideas; unexpected decisions; creative images; scientific hypotheses. The history of science and art knows many examples when important ideas came to people after sleep or rest. Sleep and personality development A good night's sleep helps a person: understand yourself better; easier to learn; maintain emotional balance; make more informed decisions; maintain physical health; be more patient in relationships. Thus, sleep becomes one of the fundamental conditions for the harmonious development of personality. Healthy sleep practices In New Psychology DREVO recommends: maintain a relatively consistent sleep schedule; reduce the amount of bright light and screen time before bed; don't overload yourself with heavy work late in the evening; ventilate the room; create a calm atmosphere; end the day with gratitude and a brief analysis of the day. These habits can improve sleep quality for many people, although individual needs vary. The main principle Sleep is not wasted time. This is recovery time. In a dream, a person does not stop developing. It creates the conditions that make the next day's development possible. Definition Sleep is a natural physiological state of the body, during which the body recovers, information is processed, memory is consolidated, emotional adaptation occurs, and a person prepares for further active life. In DREVO's New Psychology, sleep is considered one of the foundations of psychological health and personal development. Maintaining the quality of sleep is about maintaining the body, psyche, consciousness, willpower, and one's ability to live consciously. Just as a tree grows not only during the day, but also at night, imperceptibly strengthening its roots, so a person develops not only during activity, but also during a good night's sleep, when the body restores strength for a new stage of life. Human biofield The Human Biofield in New Psychology DREVO In the New Psychology DREVO, a person is viewed not only as a biochemical, but also as a bioelectrical system. Every living cell in the body supports electrical processes. The nervous system transmits signals using electrical impulses. The heart creates electrical and magnetic activity. The brain generates complex electrical rhythms. Muscles and internal organs also have their own bioelectrical activity. The combination of these processes formshuman biofield. What is a biofield? A biofield is a set of electrical and magnetic processes that occur in the body as a result of the vital activity of its cells, tissues and organs. Modern medicine records individual manifestations of these processes using various methods. For example: electrocardiography (ECG); electroencephalography (EEG); electromyography (EMG); magnetoencephalography (MEG); magnetocardiography. These methods confirm that a living organism continuously produces measurable bioelectrical activity. Biofield as a reflection of the body's state The biofield cannot be considered separately from the body. It reflects the functioning of the body. Change in heart rhythm. Brain work. Breathing. Emotional state. Physical activity. All these processes are accompanied by changes in the bioelectrical activity of the body. Thus, the biofield is one of the manifestations of human life activity. Biofield and psyche Mental processes are closely connected with the work of the brain, nervous system and the whole organism. Changes in emotional state are accompanied by physiological changes. Stress, relaxation, concentration, physical activity and sleep alter the body's bioelectric processes. In the New Psychology DREVO, the biofield is considered one of the physiological aspects of the connection between the body and the psyche. Biofield and interaction A person constantly interacts with the environment. He perceives light. Sound. Temperature. Electromagnetic fields of natural and artificial origin. The body continuously reacts to these influences. The question of the extent to which the biofields of different people directly influence each other remains a subject of scientific research and does not have a definitive answer. Therefore, New Psychology DREVO considers this topic as a promising direction for further study. Biofield and health The state of the body is reflected in its physiological processes. A good night's sleep. Physical activity. Quality food. Emotional balance. Stress management. Healthy relationships. All these factors influence the coordination of the various body systems. Taking care of your health is also taking care of the normal functioning of the body's bioelectric processes. Biofield and the future of science The development of biophysics, neuroscience, physiology and medical technologies is gradually expanding the understanding of human bioelectric processes. DREVO's new psychology suggests that further research will help to better understand the relationship between the body's physiology, psyche, consciousness, and their interaction with the environment. At the same time, any new ideas require experimental verification and scientific confirmation. The main principle The biofield does not exist separately from a person. It is a manifestation of the life of the organism. The more harmoniously the body, psyche, consciousness and lifestyle of a person interact, the more coordinated the physiological systems of the body work. Definition The human biofield is a set of bioelectrical and biomagnetic processes that occur in the body as a result of the vital activity of cells, tissues and organs and reflect its physiological state. In DREVO's New Psychology, the biofield is viewed as one of the levels of the human being's holistic organization, linking the body's physiological processes with its interaction with the environment. The study of these processes is seen as a promising direction for the development of human science. Humans live not only thanks to chemical reactions, but also thanks to the continuous exchange of electrical signals within their own bodies. The biofield is one manifestation of this living dynamic.

title: Biofield interaction
excerpt: Interaction of Biofields in the New Psychology of DREVO In the New Psychology DREVO, a person is viewed as an open living system, constantly interacting with the environment and other people. Each organism creates bioele
text: Interaction of Biofields in the New Psychology of DREVO In the New Psychology DREVO, a person is viewed as an open living system, constantly interacting with the environment and other people. Each organism creates bioelectrical and biomagnetic activity associated with the functioning of the heart, brain, nervous system and other organs. When people meet, different types of interactions occur simultaneously. Biological. Psychological. Social. Informational. And, according to the DREVO research model, physiological interactions related to the body's bioelectric processes are also possible. Four levels of interaction The first level is physiological People influence each other through voice, touch, smell, facial expressions, body temperature, breathing, and a variety of other biological signals. These mechanisms are well studied by modern science. The second level is psychological The emotions, mood and behavior of one person can influence the emotional state of another. Empathy, emotional contagion, and behavioral synchronization are well-known psychological phenomena. The third level is informational People constantly exchange knowledge, ideas, symbols and culture. It is this level that ensures the development of language, science, art and civilization. The fourth level is biofield In New Psychology DREVO, a research hypothesis is put forward that bioelectric processes of different organisms can also be involved in human interactions. The extent of such interaction, its mechanisms and significance require further study using biophysics, neuroscience and physiology. This hypothesis is not considered an established scientific fact. Harmonization When people work together, talk, sing, dance, meditate, exercise, or create something together, they often develop a coherence of movement, attention, breathing, and emotional state. Scientific research shows that such synchronization can be observed at the level of behavior and some physiological processes. The DREVO model suggests that such processes may be part of a broader phenomenon of human systems alignment. Biofield and relationships Interaction between people is never determined solely by biofield processes. It is simultaneously influenced by: words; actions; trust; past experience; values; culture; physiological state; environment. Therefore, the biofield is considered as one of the possible components of a complex system of human communication, and not as its only basis. Psychological ecology of communication Every meeting between people leaves a trace. We pass on to each other: knowledge; emotions; mood; attitude; confidence; anxiety; inspiration. Therefore, caring about our own internal state simultaneously becomes caring about the people with whom we interact. The Future of Research New Psychology DREVO considers the study of the interaction of biofields as a promising direction of science. The development of sensitive methods for recording physiological processes, biophysics, neuroscience, and computational modeling can expand our understanding of how people influence each other. Any new findings must be based on reproducible research and critical scientific scrutiny. The main principle Man never exists in isolation. Every meeting becomes a mutual exchange. We influence each other with words. By actions. Emotions. Behavior. And possibly some physiological processes that are not yet fully understood. Definition Biofield interaction is a research concept of the New Psychology DREVO, which suggests that the physiological bioelectric processes of the body can be one of the factors of interaction between people, along with psychological, social and informational mechanisms. The new DREVO psychology views humans as open systems in which internal states influence the quality of communication, collaboration, and shared development. Regardless of the mechanisms of this influence confirmed by future research, developing respect, trust, empathy, and responsibility remains the foundation of healthy human relationships. When one person develops, it's not just they who change. The space of relationships they are a part of changes. Soul, biofield and spirit Anthropological Model of New Psychology DREVO In the New Psychology DREVO, a person is viewed as a multidimensional system in which biological, psychological and philosophical levels form a single whole. Each level performs its own function. The body provides the material basis for life. The subconscious controls automatic processes. The psyche perceives and processes information. Consciousness makes a choice. Will turns choice into action. The superconscious opens up new possibilities. The soul preserves the internal integrity of the personality. The spirit sets the direction of development. Despite the differences in functions, all levels interact with each other. Soul and biofield In the DREVO philosophical model, the soul is considered as the inner core of the personality. The biofield is considered a physiological manifestation of the body's vital activity, arising due to the work of the heart, brain, nervous system and other organs. DREVO puts forward a research hypothesis that the biofield can serve as one of the levels of manifestation of a person’s holistic state and reflect the coherence of his physiological processes. In this case, the soul is not identified with the biofield. The biofield is a measurable physiological phenomenon. Soul is a philosophical concept that describes the inner authenticity of a person. The connection between them is considered a subject for further research, rather than an established scientific fact. Spirit as a directed flow In the New Psychology of DREVO, the spirit is seen as a force that gives direction to human development. In many philosophical and spiritual traditions, the spirit is symbolically described as a vertical flow that connects a person with what he considers to be the highest reality, highest values, truth, nature, God, or the universal order of the world. DREVO uses this image as a philosophical model. The vertical direction symbolizes a person’s desire to go beyond everyday needs and live for a higher purpose. For some people, this source is religious beliefs. For others, it is truth, love, science, service to society, nature, or human dignity. Thus, the spirit is understood not as a physical flow of energy, but as the direction of the individual towards what he considers to be the highest value. The horizontal and vertical axes of a person The DREVO model proposes to consider human development through two interconnected axes. Horizontal axisreflects the interaction of man with the material world: Body → Subconscious → Psyche → Consciousness → Society → Nature. She answers the question: "How am I living?" vertical axisreflects the internal development of the individual: Biofield → Soul → Spirit → Values ​​→ Purpose. She answers the question: "What do I live for?" The intersection of these two axes forms the integral personality. The principle of consistency The more the body, psyche, consciousness, values, soul and spirit are aligned with each other, the more integral a person becomes. This consistency is demonstrated by: in inner peace; in clarity of thinking; in resilience in the face of difficulties; in the ability to love; in creative activities; in respect for life. The main principle The new psychology of DREVO considers a person as a unity of two dimensions. Horizontalhelps a person live in peace. Verticalhelps to understand what he lives for. Harmonious development begins when both axes are united into a single system, where knowledge becomes wisdom, freedom becomes responsibility, and life becomes a source of creation. Definition In DREVO's New Psychology, the soul is viewed as the philosophical core of the personality, the biofield as a physiological manifestation of the body's vital activity, and the spirit as an internal vector that guides a person toward higher values ​​and purpose. Their interrelationship forms a holistic model of a person, uniting the physical, psychological and ideological dimensions of the personality and serving as a basis for further research and development practice. Part III. Laws of Personality Development The law of life Life strives for development. Every living organism has an internal drive for growth, adaptation and self-preservation. Development is a natural state of man. Stopping development leads to gradual degradation. Law of Integrity A human being is a single system. The body, subconscious, psyche, consciousness, superconsciousness, soul, spirit, values, social connections and the environment constantly influence each other. It is impossible to change one part of the system without affecting the others. The law of cause and effect Every thought influences emotions. Emotions influence decisions. Decisions become actions. Actions become habits. Habits shape character. Character determines a person's life path. The Law of Awareness Development begins with observation. A person can change only what he can understand. Mindfulness turns automatic life into free choice. The Law of Will Willpower is the ability to control oneself and make conscious choices. The greater a person's ability to control his thoughts, emotions and actions, the greater his inner freedom. Law of Responsibility Freedom is impossible without responsibility. Every decision has consequences. A person becomes mature when he accepts responsibility for his thoughts, words, actions and their impact on other people and the world around him. The Law of Harmony True development does not destroy the system. The development of the body should not come at the cost of the destruction of the psyche. Personal development should not destroy the family. Economic development should not destroy nature. Harmony is the ability to develop while maintaining the stability of the entire system. The Law of Overcoming Growth is impossible without overcoming difficulties. Challenges are not the opposite of growth. They are a natural part of it. By overcoming obstacles, a person develops strength, wisdom and resilience. Law of Cooperation A person reveals his potential through interaction with other people. Competition promotes the development of individual abilities. Cooperation promotes the development of civilization. The Law of Psychological Ecology A person's inner world depends on the environment in which he lives. Information, relationships, culture, nature and technology constantly shape the state of the psyche. Taking care of your internal and external environment is a necessary condition for psychological health. The Law of Creation The highest form of development is creation. Human development becomes complete when he begins to create not only for himself, but also for others. Creation transforms knowledge into culture, work into heritage, and life into a source of social development. The Law of Destiny Each person has a unique combination of abilities, experiences and values. Purpose is revealed when a person uses his abilities for the development of life, society and future generations. Law of Inheritance The true value of life is determined not by the amount accumulated, but by what a person leaves behind. Knowledge. Children. Culture. Scientific discoveries. Good works. Created communities. Restored nature. True development continues even after man's departure.

title: The Main Law of New Psychology DREVO
excerpt: A person develops harmoniously when each of his decisions simultaneously strengthens him, benefits other people and contributes to the preservation and development of life in all its manifestations. This is precisely the
text: A person develops harmoniously when each of his decisions simultaneously strengthens him, benefits other people and contributes to the preservation and development of life in all its manifestations. This is precisely the path of a mature individual, a creative society and a sustainable civilization. The law of life The Law of Life in New Psychology DREVO In the New Psychology DREVO, life is viewed as a continuous process of development, interaction and creation. All living things are born. It's growing. Studies. Adapts. Creates. Passes on experience. Leaves a legacy. And becomes part of the future. This process can be called the Law of Life. It manifests itself in nature, in the development of man, family, society and civilization. What is the Law of Life? The law of life is a natural principle according to which all living things strive to preserve life, develop, interact with the surrounding world, create something new, and pass on the results of their existence to future generations. Life does not exist in stillness. It exists in constant development. Five Manifestations of the Law of Life Preservation of life Every living organism strives to maintain its existence. Therefore, caring for health, safety and well-being is a natural part of life. Development Life is constantly changing. The child becomes an adult. The seed becomes a tree. Knowledge becomes wisdom. The cessation of development gradually leads to the loss of vitality. Cooperation No person develops completely alone. Life exists through interaction. Family. Community. Nature. Ecosystems. Cooperation is as natural a law of life as development. Creation Life not only preserves itself. She creates something new. Children. Ideas. Culture. Technologies. Works of art. Good deeds. Creation becomes a natural continuation of development. Heritage Life goes on through transmission. Transfer of knowledge. Experience. Values. Cultures. Caring for nature. Each generation receives peace from the previous one and passes it on to the next. The law of life and man A person becomes truly alive when he participates in all five processes. He takes care of his health. Developing. Builds relationships. Creates something new. Leaves behind a legacy. If even one of these directions disappears, life gradually loses harmony. The law of life and happiness Happiness arises when a person lives in accordance with the Law of life. It is developing. Loves. Creates. Helps others. Feels the meaning of his existence. Therefore, happiness is not a separate goal, but a natural consequence of life lived in accordance with its laws. The Law of Life and Civilization This law does not apply only to the individual. It also applies to society. A civilization becomes sustainable when: preserves life; develops education and science; strengthens cooperation; creates new opportunities; cares about nature; thinks about future generations. Violation of these principles gradually weakens any society. Practice of the Law of Life Every day it is useful to ask yourself: What helped save your life today? What new things have I learned? What have I created? Who did you help? What from today will become part of the future? These questions help you live consciously and see your place in the continuous development of life. The main principle Life does not exist for the sake of accumulation. Life exists for the sake of continuing life. The more a person contributes to the development of life around him, the more fully his own life unfolds. Definition The law of life is a universal principle according to which life strives to preserve itself, develop, cooperate, create and pass on its legacy to future generations. In DREVO's New Psychology, the Law of Life is one of the fundamental principles of personal and social development. It demonstrates that the meaning of human life lies not only in personal well-being, but also in participating in the continuous process of development, creation, and transmission of life. Like a tree that draws strength from its roots, grows toward the light, bears fruit, and gives seeds to new trees, a person becomes part of the Law of Life when he not only lives himself, but also helps life to continue around him. Law of Integrity The Law of Integrity in New Psychology DREVO In the New Psychology DREVO, a person is viewed as a single living system. Body. Subconscious. Psyche. Consciousness. Will. Soul. Spirit. Values. Social connections. Interaction with nature. All these levels do not exist separately from each other. They interact constantly. Changing one level inevitably affects the others. This is why personal development must be holistic. What is the Law of Integrity? The law of integrity is a principle according to which a person develops as a single interconnected system, and the harmony of the personality is achieved not by the maximum development of one of its parts, but by the coordinated development of all levels. Development without harmony creates internal imbalance. The unity of man The body influences the psyche. The psyche influences thinking. Consciousness influences decisions. Will turns decisions into actions. Actions form habits. Habits change character. Character determines one's life path. It is impossible to change one part of a personality without affecting the others. Imbalance Sometimes a person develops only one side of his personality. For example: He has a lot of knowledge, but he doesn't know how to build relationships. Or has a strong will, but has lost his sense of compassion. Or he achieved material success, but lost the meaning of life. Such achievements may be significant, but they do not create an inner sense of integrity. Harmony requires the development of all the main aspects of personality. Integrity and health Mental health cannot be reduced to the absence of mental disorders. It includes: physical well-being; emotional stability; clarity of thinking; ability to make decisions; moral maturity; healthy relationships; sense of meaning; ability to create. The more consistent these elements are, the more stable a person is. Integrity and Society This law applies not only to the individual. Family. Community. Organization. State. Civilization. Any system remains stable only when its parts cooperate with each other. If one part develops at the expense of the destruction of others, the entire system gradually begins to suffer. Practice of Integrity It is helpful to ask yourself questions regularly. Am I focusing too much on one area of ​​my life and neglecting others? Am I developing simultaneously as an individual, as a family member, as a professional, and as a human being? Do I devote enough time to my health? Relationships? Training? Rest? Creation? Every month it is useful to evaluate all ten levels of personal development and seek balance between them. Law of the Tree A tree cannot develop only by roots. Or just the trunk. Or just leaves. All parts must grow at the same time. The roots feed the tree. The trunk holds it. The branches reach towards the light. Leaves provide energy. The fruits continue to live. A person develops in the same way. The main principle It is impossible to become a harmonious personality by developing only individual abilities. True development occurs when the body, psyche, consciousness, will, soul, spirit, relationships and lifestyle support each other. Definition The Law of Integrity is a fundamental principle of DREVO's New Psychology, which holds that a person is a unified system of interconnected levels, and sustainable development is only possible through their harmonious interaction. An imbalance at one level eventually affects others. Conversely, strengthening one level can support the development of others if it aligns with overall values ​​and life direction. Just as a tree lives through the unity of its roots, trunk, branches, leaves and fruits, a person becomes truly strong when all aspects of his personality develop as a whole. The law of cause and effect The Law of Cause and Effect in New Psychology DREVO In the New Psychology DREVO, life is viewed as a continuous chain of causes and effects. Nothing comes into being by itself. Every thought has consequences. Every decision affects the future. Every action changes a person and the world around him. Therefore, the quality of life gradually becomes a reflection of many daily choices. The law of cause and effect is one of the fundamental laws of personal development. What is the Law of Cause and Effect? The law of cause and effect is the principle that every action, decision, or inaction produces consequences that affect the individual, their relationships, society, and the future. This law operates regardless of whether a person notices it or not. Causes create consequences Thoughts become words. Words become decisions. Decisions become actions. Actions become habits. Habits shape character. Character gradually determines the path of life. That's why big changes rarely happen overnight. They are the result of many small causes. Responsibility for choice The law of cause and effect makes a person free and at the same time responsible. Freedom lies in the ability to choose. Responsibility is the willingness to accept the consequences of your choices. You can't always choose the consequences. But you can choose the reasons from which they arise.

title: The reasons vary.
excerpt: Not all consequences arise from the actions of just one person. Life is influenced by: natural processes; health; other people's decisions; social conditions; random events. However, even in these circumstances, a person
text: Not all consequences arise from the actions of just one person. Life is influenced by: natural processes; health; other people's decisions; social conditions; random events. However, even in these circumstances, a person is able to choose his attitude, his further actions and the direction of development. It is this ability that remains within his area of ​​responsibility. The Law of Cause and Effect and Personality Every day a person shapes his future. If he: studies; takes care of health; strengthens relationships; keeps promises; creates useful projects, then gradually creates the grounds for a more stable and fulfilling life. If you constantly put off important things, avoid responsibility, or destroy relationships, the consequences also accumulate over time. The law of cause and effect in society This law also operates at the societal level. Honesty breeds trust. Trust facilitates cooperation. Cooperation creates development. Development improves the quality of life. And vice versa: lies destroy trust; mistrust destroys cooperation; Destroyed cooperation weakens society. Practice of conscious choice Before making an important decision, it is useful to ask yourself questions: What consequences could this act have? Will it be useful in a year? In ten years? Does it align with my values? Will it help the development of life? Thus, a person begins to think not only about today’s results, but also about long-term consequences. The law of cause and effect and karma In the New Psychology of DREVO, the concept of karma is considered as one of the manifestations of the law of cause and effect. Karma is the accumulated consequences of thoughts, decisions, actions and habits. It is not a mystical punishment. It is a natural result of human lifestyle. The main principle The future does not happen by chance. It gradually grows out of today's decisions. It is impossible to change your future without changing the reasons that create it. Definition The law of cause and effect is a fundamental principle of personal development, according to which every action, decision, habit, or inaction inevitably creates consequences that affect the person themselves, those around them, and the further development of life. In the New Psychology of DREVO, this law is considered the foundation of personal responsibility. It reminds us that we cannot control everything that happens, but we can consciously choose the factors that gradually shape our character, relationships, and life path. Every action today is a seed for the future. What the tree of life will become depends not on one great event, but on the seeds a person sows every day. The Law of Awareness The Law of Awareness in New Psychology DREVO Awareness is the main difference between a person and automatic behavior. A person is born with many innate reflexes and gradually forms habits. Most of our daily activities are performed automatically. This is natural. But it is the ability to be aware of one’s thoughts, feelings, desires and actions that makes a person a free individual. In the New Psychology of DREVO, awareness is the basis of all other laws of development. Without it, it is impossible to develop will. It is impossible to change habits. It is impossible to reveal one's purpose. What is the Law of Awareness? The Law of Awareness is a fundamental principle that states that a person's level of development is determined by their ability to understand themselves, notice what is happening, make conscious choices, and accept responsibility for the consequences of their decisions. Mindfulness transforms life from a chain of random reactions into a path of conscious development. Mindfulness creates freedom Every event causes a reaction. But between the event and the reaction there is a space of choice. It is in this space that freedom is born. The more a person is able to notice his thoughts, emotions and impulses, the less he becomes their hostage. Freedom does not begin when restrictions disappear. It begins when a person is able to choose his reaction. Four levels of awareness The first level is body awareness The man notices: fatigue; voltage; pain; breath; energy; the body's needs. This is the basis of health. The second level is awareness of the psyche A person begins to understand: your emotions; fears; desires; habits; automatic reactions. He ceases to fully identify himself with his experiences. The third level is awareness of personality A person asks questions: Who am I? What do I believe in? Why do I make these particular decisions? What values ​​define my life? This is where true self-knowledge begins. The fourth level is awareness of life A person begins to see himself as part of a wider world. He realizes the connection: with family; community; nature; humanity; future generations. Personal development becomes part of life development. What hinders awareness? Awareness is reduced by: constant rush; chronic stress; information noise; life by habit; dependencies; fear of admitting one's own mistakes; lack of time for reflection. When attention is constantly scattered, it becomes difficult for a person to manage his life. How to develop mindfulness? In New Psychology DREVO this is helped by: meditation; autogenic training; thought diary; diary of emotions; diary of desires; dream diary; daily reflection; nature observation; honest self-analysis; deep conversations with people. Mindfulness is developed through regular practice of observing without self-judgment. Awareness and responsibility Awareness shows a person a choice. Responsibility helps to realize this choice. Without awareness, a person lives automatically. Without responsibility he does not use his freedom. Only together do they become the basis of a mature personality. Practice of the Law of Awareness It is helpful to ask yourself five questions every day: What do I feel now? What am I thinking about? Why do I do this? Is my action consistent with my values? What would be the most constructive decision now? These questions gradually turn mindfulness into a habit. The main principle Mindfulness doesn't make life easier. It makes a person wiser. The more a person understands himself and the consequences of his actions, the freer, more responsible and happier his life becomes. Definition The Law of Awareness is a fundamental law of the New Psychology DREVO, according to which personal development begins with the ability to observe oneself, understand what is happening, make free choices, and accept responsibility for their consequences. Mindfulness is the foundation of self-direction, maturity, and inner freedom. It is what allows a person to transform a haphazard life into a meaningful path of development, where thoughts become decisions, decisions become actions, and actions become the foundation of a happy and creative life. Mindfulness is like light. It doesn't change the world on its own, but it allows you to see the path, discern obstacles, and take the next step with purpose. That's why personal development always begins with the ability to see. The Law of Will The Law of Will in New Psychology DREVO In the New Psychology of DREVO, willpower is viewed as a person’s ability to consciously manage themselves and direct their lives in accordance with their values, goals, and purpose. Desires arise by themselves. Emotions appear on their own. Thoughts often come spontaneously. But the action remains a person’s choice. It is the will that transforms internal choice into action. Without will, knowledge remains theory. Values ​​are intentions. Dreams are fantasies. Will connects consciousness with real life. What is the Law of Will? The law of will is a fundamental principle according to which personal development is determined not by the amount of knowledge or desires, but by a person’s ability to consistently transform conscious choices into real actions. Will makes freedom effective. Will gives birth to actions Awareness shows possible paths. Will helps to choose one of them. Every conscious action strengthens the ability to manage oneself. Every inaction also becomes a choice and gradually forms a habit. A man becomes what he regularly does. Four levels of will The first level is body control A person learns: observe the regime; take care of your health; overcome laziness; maintain discipline. This is the foundation for the development of will. The second level is managing emotions A person stops acting only under the influence of mood. He is capable of experiencing fear, anger or anxiety, but does not allow them to completely determine his behavior. The third level is life management A person begins to make decisions independently. Sets goals. Keeps promises. Finishes what he started. Lives according to his values. The fourth level is serving the purpose The highest form of willpower is manifested when a person is able to remain faithful to his purpose and moral principles even under conditions of pressure, difficulties and uncertainty. Will becomes a force directed not only towards personal success, but also towards creation. What weakens the will? The will is gradually weakened: life without goals; constant postponing of important matters; lack of routine; chronic fatigue; dependencies; the habit of looking for excuses; disclaimer. Weakening of the will rarely occurs immediately. It develops through daily concessions to oneself.

title: How to strengthen your will?
excerpt: Willpower develops through practice. Useful daily: keep the promises you make to yourself; finish what you started; do difficult but important things; limit impulsive desires; observe the regime; develop discipline; help
text: Willpower develops through practice. Useful daily: keep the promises you make to yourself; finish what you started; do difficult but important things; limit impulsive desires; observe the regime; develop discipline; help others, even when it takes effort. Will is like a muscle. It gets stronger with regular exercise. Will and freedom Freedom without will turns into dependence on circumstances. Will without awareness can turn into stubbornness. Therefore, true inner freedom is born only when awareness determines the direction, and the will helps to follow this path. Practice of the Law of Will Every evening it is useful to ask yourself the following questions: What promises did I keep today? Where did I give in to my weaknesses? What action required the most willpower? What will help me become stronger tomorrow? Small honest answers gradually build character. The main principle Willpower is not developed in rare moments of heroism. It develops in everyday life. Every time a person chooses the right over the easy, the long-term over the immediate, and creation over destruction, he strengthens his inner strength. Definition The Law of Will is a fundamental law of the New Psychology DREVO, according to which personality develops through a person's ability to consciously manage their thoughts, emotions, desires, and actions, consistently realizing their values ​​and life goals. Willpower is the link between consciousness and action. It transforms knowledge into experience, intentions into habits, and inner potential into real change in the individual and the world around us. Just as a tree's trunk holds it together between its roots and its crown, so does willpower connect a person's inner world with their actions. It is not the strength of desire that determines a person's destiny, but the strength of will to daily put into practice what they believe is right. Law of Responsibility The Law of Responsibility in New Psychology DREVO In the New Psychology DREVO, responsibility is viewed as a person’s ability to recognize themselves as the cause of their decisions, actions and their consequences. Responsibility begins the moment a person stops asking: "Who is to blame?" And he begins to ask: "What depends on me?" It is from this moment that a person ceases to be an object of circumstances and becomes the author of his own life. What is the Law of Responsibility? The law of responsibility is a fundamental principle according to which the level of personal development is determined by a person’s willingness to accept responsibility for their thoughts, decisions, actions, the consequences of their actions, and their own development. Responsibility is an extension of freedom. The more freedom, the greater the responsibility. Responsibility begins with oneself A man cannot rule the whole world. But he is able to control himself. With your thoughts. In your own words. By your actions. By your attitude to what is happening. This is where real responsibility begins.
